name: Rallly
description: Rallly is a tool for creating meeting polls. It’s designed to help you schedule meetings with groups of people. It’s free to use and you can create as many polls as you want. Authentication only works with configured SMTP settings as a code is sent to the email address. If you limit access, you should also limit the allowed email addresses, otherwise anyone can register. Examples: https://github.com/lukevella/rallly-selfhosted Reverse Proxy Configurations: https://github.com/lukevella/rallly-selfhosted/tree/main/reverse-proxy

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: A connection string to your Postgres database

variables.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
variables.description: The base url where this instance is accessible, including the scheme.

variables.name: SECRET_PASSWORD
variables.description: A random 32-character secret key used to encrypt user sessions

variables.name: SUPPORT_EMAIL
variables.description: All outgoing emails will show this email as the sender's email address, which also serves as the support email.

variables.name: SMTP_HOST
variables.description: The host address of your SMTP server

variables.name: SMTP_PORT
variables.description: The port of your SMTP server

variables.name: SMTP_SECURE
variables.description: Set to true if SSL is enabled for your SMTP connection

variables.name: SMTP_USER
variables.description: The username (if auth is enabled on your SMTP server)

variables.name: SMTP_PWD
variables.description: The password (if auth is enabled on your SMTP server)

variables.name: AUTH_REQUIRED
variables.description: Set to `true` to require authentication for creating new polls and accessing admin pages

variables.name: ALLOWED_EMAILS
variables.description: Comma separated list of email addresses that are allowed to register and login. You can use wildcard syntax to match a range of email addresses. Example: john@example.com,jane@example.com

variables.name: DISABLE_LANDING_PAGE
variables.description: Whether or not to disable the landing page

variables.name: SMTP_TLS_ENABLED
variables.description: Set to true to enable TLS. Might be needed for some SMTP connections
